license_required.quote: A person who, not being licensed, advertises or holds himself or herself out to the public as described in section 1311 of this title, or who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title

issuing_authority.quote: Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title

name.quote: Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title

type.quote: Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title

age_minimum.quote: is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: is of sound moral character and professional competence

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or equivalent from accredited medical school
degree_required.quote: has graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule, with a degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent as may be determined by the Board

accrediting_body.quote: medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training

duration.value: 2-3 years depending on medical school origin
duration.quote: at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

kind.quote: postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

exams.name: Medical licensing examination
exams.quote: An applicant shall satisfy the Board's requirements for medical licensing examination as established by the Board by rule

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license
interval_years.citation: [§ 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education]

required.quote: A licensee for renewal of an active license to practice medicine shall have completed continuing medical education that shall meet minimum criteria as established by rule
required.citation: [§ 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education]

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall require a minimum of 10 hours of continuing medical education by rule
hours_per_period.citation: [§ 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education]

period_years.quote: biennially for the renewal of his or her license
period_years.citation: [§ 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education]

value: current professional competence in recognizing need for timely appropriate consultations and referrals
knowledge of hospice, palliative care, and pain management services
topical_requirements.quote: The training provided by the continuing medical education shall be designed to assure that the licensee has updated his or her knowledge and skills in his or her own specialties and also has kept abreast of advances in other fields for which patient referrals may be appropriate. The Board shall require evidence of current professional competence in recognizing the need for timely appropriate consultations and referrals to assure fully informed patient choice of treatment options, including treatments such as those offered by hospice, palliative care, and pain management services.
topical_requirements.citation: [§ 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education]

available.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States

requirements.value: Three years of practice in good standing in another U.S. jurisdiction; postgraduate training requirements (2 years for U.S./Canadian medical school graduates, 3 years for foreign medical school graduates)
requirements.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State, provided the applicant meets one of the following postgraduate training requirements

exists.quote: Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title

national_certification.quote: a physician who is Board-certified or Board-eligible in his or her field of specialty, as determined by the American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS)

national_association.quote: in consultation with the Vermont Medical Society

regulatory_model.quote: not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title

credential_type.quote: License to practice medicine and surgery in the State

is_mandatory.quote: A person who, not being licensed, ... practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title, ... shall be imprisoned not more than two years or fined not more than $10,000.00, or both

title_protection.quote: using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition unless the designation additionally contains the description of another branch of the healing arts for which one holds a valid license in Vermont

scope_protection.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or in connection with applying for or procuring periodic renewal of a medical license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising about health care services intended to mislead or deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: all advertising about health care services or a medical business that is intended or has a tendency to mislead or deceive the public or impose upon credulous or ignorant persons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of sale of drugs, devices, or goods to exploit patients for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: promotion by a physician of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such a manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making and filing false reports or records in his or her practice as a physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file or record required medical reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding or obstructing a filing or recording, or inducing another person to omit to file or record medical reports required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make available promptly copies of patient records upon proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to make available promptly to a person using professional health care services, that person's representative, succeeding health care professionals, or institutions, when given proper written request and direction of the person using professional health care services, copies of that person's records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or profiting from agents' acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: solicitation of professional patronage by agents or persons or profiting from the acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensed physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper agreements with laboratories regarding payments for tests without disclosure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: agreeing with clinical or bio-analytical laboratories to make payments to such laboratories for individual tests or test series for patients, unless the physician discloses on the bills to patients or third party payors the name of such laboratory, the amount or amounts to such laboratory for individual tests or test series, and the amount of his or her processing charge or procurement, if any, for each specimen taken

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful misrepresentation in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with a physician not legally practicing within the State
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding or abetting such physician in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Consistent improper utilization of services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: consistent improper utilization of services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Consistent use of nonaccepted procedures with detrimental effect upon patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: consistent use of nonaccepted procedures that have a consistent detrimental effect upon patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by person, group, or corporation when not actually in charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: permitting one's name or license to be used by a person, group, or corporation when not actually in charge of, responsible for, or actively overseeing the treatment or other health care services provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross failure to use and exercise degree of care, skill, and proficiency commonly exercised by ordinary skillful physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in the course of practice, gross failure to use and exercise on a particular occasion or the failure to use and exercise on repeated occasions, that degree of care, skill, and proficiency that is commonly exercised by the ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent physician engaged in similar practice under the same or similar conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation of license or disciplinary sanction by another jurisdiction on grounds specified in this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation of a license to practice medicine or surgery, or other disciplinary sanction, by another jurisdiction on one or more of the grounds specified in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with Board order or violation of license restrictions or conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a license that is restricted or conditioned by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing nurse practitioner to perform medical acts outside usual scope or for which not qualified
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any physician who, in the course of a collaborative agreement with a nurse practitioner allows the nurse practitioner to perform a medical act that is outside the usual scope of the physician's own practice or that the nurse practitioner is not qualified to perform by training or experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with federal statutes or regulations or state statutes or rules governing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with provisions of federal statutes or regulations, or the statutes or rules of this or any other state, governing the practice of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegation of professional responsibilities to person not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegation of professional responsibilities, including delivery of any health care services, to a person whom the licensed professional knows, or has reason to know, is not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of crime related to practice or felony, or failure to report conviction within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession or conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of the profession, or failure to report to the Board a conviction of any crime related to the practice of the profession or any felony in any court within 30 days of the conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of anesthesiologist assistant services inconsistent with statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of the services of an anesthesiologist assistant by an anesthesiologist in a manner that is inconsistent with the provisions of chapter 29 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of radiologist assistant services inconsistent with statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of the services of a radiologist assistant by a radiologist in a manner that is inconsistent with the provisions of chapter 52 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing medical services or prescription medication via electronic means without proper physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide Board with information it reasonably requests
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide to the Board such information it may reasonably request in furtherance of its statutory duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior that interferes with patient care or quality of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disruptive behavior that involves interaction with physicians, hospital personnel, office staff, patients, or support persons of the patient or others that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the quality of care rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient, surrogates, or key third parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, ordering, or dispensing controlled substance for own use or immediate family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, ordering, or dispensing any drug legally classified as a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank or undated prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: signing a blank or undated prescription form

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of conversion therapy on client younger than 18 years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of conversion therapy as defined in 18 V.S.A. § 8351 on a client younger than 18 years of age

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements for unapproved stem cell products
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with one or more of the notice, disclosure, or advertising requirements in 18 V.S.A. § 4502 for administering stem cell or stem cell-related products not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice competently by reason of any cause on single or multiple occasions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to practice competently by reason of any cause on a single occasion or on multiple occasions constitutes unprofessional conduct

definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine means: using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition; advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that one is authorized to practice medicine in the jurisdiction; offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care; offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person; rendering a written or otherwise documented medical opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient or the actual rendering of treatment to a patient within the State by a physician located outside the State as a result of the transmission of individual patient data by electronic or other means from within the State to the physician or his or her agent; or rendering a determination of medical necessity or a decision affecting the diagnosis or treatment of a patient
definition_quote.quote: Practice of medicine means: (A) using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition unless the designation additionally contains the description of another branch of the healing arts for which one holds a valid license in Vermont; (B) advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that one is authorized to practice medicine in the jurisdiction; (C) offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; (D) offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care; (E) offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person; (F) rendering a written or otherwise documented medical opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient or the actual rendering of treatment to a patient within the State by a physician located outside the State as a result of the transmission of individual patient data by electronic or other means from within the State to the physician or his or her agent; or (G) rendering a determination of medical necessity or a decision affecting the diagnosis or treatment of a patient

value: management of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care
methods_authorized.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care; offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person

drug_authority.value: Authority to prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs and medicines
drug_authority.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must submit evidence of ECFMG certification and complete at least 3 years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization acceptable to the Board
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A graduate of a Board-approved medical school outside the United States or Canada shall submit evidence of success of completing at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board... A graduate of a medical school outside the United States or Canada shall also submit evidence of certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates unless the individual qualifies for licensure as a Fifth Pathway applicant, as established by the Board by rule.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: This subchapter is the Vermont adoption of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact as revised by the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: All medical malpractice court judgments and all medical malpractice arbitration awards in which a payment is awarded to a complaining party during the last 10 years, and all settlements of medical malpractice claims in which a payment is made to a complaining party within the last 10 years

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A description of revocation or involuntary restriction of hospital privileges for reasons related to competence or character that has been issued by the hospital's governing body or any other official of the hospital after procedural due process has been afforded, or the resignation from, or nonrenewal of, medical staff membership or the restriction of privileges at a hospital taken in lieu of, or in settlement of, a pending disciplinary case related to competence or character in that hospital

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the Vermont Practitioner Recovery Network, which, for the protection of the public, monitors and evaluates, coordinates services for, and promotes rehabilitation of licensees who have or potentially have an impaired ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require a licensee or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination, and an evaluation of medical knowledge and skill by individuals or entities designated by the Board if the Board has a reasonable basis to believe a licensee or applicant may be incompetent or unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety
compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.citation: [§ 1353. Powers and duties of the Board]
